paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Pinchas, remez 776, saying: since “expiring” is stated explicitly of Aaron and not of Moses, it says here, “you too.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet paragraph at Yalkut Torah 776 contains the stated argument about Aaron, Moses and “you too,” naming Rav Assi ben Matya. Hyman’s heading has abbreviated ר' and bar Matya. R' retains that title without imposing the digital Rav or changing bar to ben; no identity merger or Hebrew repair is made.
